loops.name: adversarial-review-loop
loops.description: Has a second, independent model review every change before merge so two different reviewers must agree — code only lands when both clear the bar.
loops.author: aimirah

loops.name: builder-reviewer-loop
loops.description: Passes code between a builder and an independent reviewer subagent until the review has no blocking findings and tests pass.
loops.author: aimirah

loops.name: devils-advocate-loop
loops.description: Adversarially challenges a design or decision until every serious objection is resolved or explicitly accepted.
loops.author: aimirah

loops.name: docs-sweep-loop
loops.description: Keeps documentation aligned with the current codebase and opens a reviewable pull request on every pass.

loops.description: Recovers valuable unmerged work and prunes stale branches and PRs until the repository is tidy.
loops.author: aimirah

loops.name: quality-streak-loop
loops.description: Runs realistic scenarios and fixes failures until the suite passes N times in a row with no regressions.
loops.author: aimirah

loops.name: five-minute-maintainer-loop
loops.description: Every few minutes while you work, makes one small verified repository improvement — a flaky test, a stale comment, a missing type — one change, one commit.
loops.author: aimirah

loops.name: goal-refiner-loop
loops.description: Rewrites a vague request into a precise goal — exact end state, how to verify it, what not to touch, and the stop condition — then executes against it.
loops.author: aimirah

loops.name: perf-budget-loop
loops.description: Profiles and optimizes the app pass after pass until it consistently meets a defined performance budget.
loops.author: aimirah

loops.name: production-error-sweep-loop
loops.description: Triages production errors, finds the root cause, ships a verified fix, and repeats until the error budget is clean.
loops.author: aimirah

loops.name: test-coverage-loop
loops.description: Adds meaningful tests pass after pass until the suite reaches a target coverage threshold and stays green.
loops.author: aimirah

loops.name: ticket-to-pr-loop
loops.description: Converts open bug reports and issues into verified, reviewer-ready pull requests, one ticket per pass.
loops.author: aimirah

loops.name: human-approval-loop

loops.name: nightly-changelog-loop

loops.author: aimirah
